summary: Narcotics case under NDPS Act; non-compliance with Section 52A regarding magistrate certification for inventory/samples; hostile witnesses affecting evidence; reliance on FSL report; mandatory procedure for disposal of seized contraband examined; procedural safeguards for fair investigation discussed; validity of certificate of destruction assessed.
legal_provisions_cited: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.8(b), s.15(c), s.25, s.29, s.52A
final_judgment: Appeal decided based on procedural compliance with Section 52A; conviction assessed for adherence to mandatory evidentiary standards.
